findings.detail: The touched code keeps `forecastData?.map((s: any) => ...)` on a directly modified line. Because the data comes from the generated Convex API (`api.analytics.pipelineForecast`), the element type should already be available; the `: any` bypasses exhaustiveness and rename safety. Remove the annotation or add a typed intermediate shape instead of disabling the checker.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop `: any` so the mapper uses the generated type. If the chart component expects a different shape, define a local `PipelineChartDeal` type or inline the expected fields with a narrow type.

findings.summary: Icon props typed as `typeof FileText` / `typeof Phone` instead of `LucideIcon`
findings.detail: `EmptyState` declares `icon: typeof FileText` and `ACTIVITY_ICONS` uses `Record<string, typeof Phone>`. These happen to work because all lucide icons share the same component signature, but they communicate the wrong intent and will break type hygiene if the icon library changes. The idiomatic type is `LucideIcon` from `lucide-react`.
findings.suggested_fix: Import `LucideIcon` from `lucide-react` and use it for both `EmptyState.icon` and `ACTIVITY_ICONS`.

residual_risks.detail: The `overview.agingDeals` data is no longer rendered anywhere on this page. If this was the only surface for that data, users lose visibility into stale deals. Confirm the removal is intentional and that the data is surfaced elsewhere (e.g., the dedicated deals page) before shipping.

residual_risks.summary: Cards wrapped as anchors require no nested interactive children
residual_risks.detail: KPI cards and activity rows are now full `<Link>` anchors. This is valid HTML and currently contains no nested links or buttons, but future edits inside these cards could accidentally introduce nested interactive elements, which breaks accessibility and Next.js routing.

testing_gaps.summary: No tests for Link-wrapped KPI cards and activity rows
testing_gaps.detail: The new click targets are structural/behavioral changes. Consider adding lightweight tests (RTL or Playwright) that the KPI cards and each activity row navigate to the expected hrefs.

testing_gaps.summary: No tests for EmptyState CTA buttons
testing_gaps.detail: EmptyState now renders an optional `Button asChild > Link`. Verify that the CTA renders only when `action` is provided and that the href is correct.
